_comment: Per-fixture expectations for the round-trip gate (test/roundtrip.test.js).
Any corpus file NOT listed here must be editable and must round-trip byte-identically.
A file listed with identity:'fail' is a KNOWN defect. The gate asserts it still fails,
so fixing the parser forces an update here — that is the point. When a fix lands,
delete the entry and the file becomes a permanent regression test.
severity:'corruption' means the emitted file is not equivalent to the input —
it changes meaning or is invalid Astro. Those are bugs, not formatting drift.
severity:'formatting' means the output is semantically the same file, reformatted.

spread-props.astro.note: `<Button {...rest} />` is emitted as `<Button ...rest />` — invalid Astro, breaks the build. parseAttrs (astroParser.js:38) accepts `.` in its name character class, so `...rest` matches as a bare attribute name and serializeAttrs re-emits it without braces.

side-effect-css-import.astro.note: Import order is rewritten: IMPORT_RE (astroParser.js:19) matches default imports only, so `import '../styles/reset.css'` falls into extraFrontmatter and is emitted BELOW the hoisted default imports. Style import order determines cascade order, so saving a page can restyle it.

named-imports.astro.note: Same root cause as side-effect-css-import: `import { getCollection } from 'astro:content'` is not matched by IMPORT_RE and is reordered below default imports.

namespace-import.astro.note: Same root cause: `import * as utils from '../lib/utils'` is reordered below default imports.

interleaved-frontmatter.astro.note: Imports are hoisted above frontmatter statements that originally preceded them. If a hoisted import's module has side effects, or a const is used in a later import path, hoisting changes evaluation order.

no-frontmatter.astro.note: A file with no frontmatter gains an empty `---\n---` block: serializePage (astroParser.js:349) emits the fences unconditionally.

frontmatter-blank-lines.astro.note: Leading and trailing blank lines inside the frontmatter are lost to extraFrontmatter.trim() (astroParser.js:298).

four-space-indent.astro.note: serializeNode re-indents the whole tree at two spaces per level, so a project using four-space indentation has every page reformatted on first save.

map-loop.astro.note: A `{items.map(...)}` loop is re-emitted with the brace, head and `))` on their own lines at a fixed indent (astroParser.js:424-429) instead of its original layout.

style-and-script.astro.note: Blank lines around top-level `<style>`/`<script>` blocks are dropped — whitespace-only text nodes are discarded at parse (astroParser.js:155) and the raw serializer trims its own surroundings (astroParser.js:436).

comments-and-doctype.astro.note: Gains a trailing blank line: serializePage joins lines and appends '\n' to a list that already ends in an empty entry.

dynamic-tag.astro.note: Trailing blank line added at EOF (same cause as comments-and-doctype).

expressions.astro.note: Trailing blank line added at EOF (same cause as comments-and-doctype).

inline-run.astro.note: Trailing blank line added at EOF (same cause as comments-and-doctype).

props-interface.astro.note: Trailing blank line added at EOF. This is Stacki's own scaffold shape — the app does not round-trip the files it generates.
